messages.author: 2f3428d3166aad1c
messages.subject: Shiny not binding all outputs
parts:
I have an app with custom outputs that are not working anymore with 0.12.  It is not a jsonlite issue.  

My custom outputs are mustache templates rendered with the data passed from a shiny "renderTemplate" function.  Some of the divs containing these outputs are dynamically generated when the page loads (but not from R - this is a custom UI).  Sometimes shiny recognizes them as shiny bound outputs and sometimes it doesn't.  I can get around the problem if I increase the timeout on the timeout for initShiny.  But that is not a good solution.  In versions before 0.12 I could call Shiny.unbindAll() followed by Shiny.bindAll().  But in 0.12, Shiny.bindAll() still does not find all of the elements defined by the scope of my custom output, and it doesn't work.

Any idea on what might have changed or how I might get around this issue?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Shiny not binding all outputs
parts:
Not that it matters, but I don't think the unbindAll is necessary here; the unbindAll/bindAll pattern usually goes:

unbindAll(el);
// mutate el
bindAll(el);

bindAll is supposed to be smart enough to automatically skip any already-bound elements. I think.

Anyway... you said sometimes they're bound, sometimes they're not. Does that mean it's not deterministic? i.e. the same output might be bound sometimes, others not, with no code changes?
